expo.name: MOOD

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to record photos and videos when you create workout posts or share fitness content.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: The photo library is used to select existing photos and videos when you create workout posts or share fitness content. For example, you can upload a progress photo from your gallery.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Photos and videos are saved to your library when you download or save content from the app. For example, saving a workout summary image to your camera roll.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used to record audio when you create and upload videos or posts. For example, audio is captured when recording a workout video.
